from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import PaymentGatewayCredential

class RevealPaymentGatewaySecretView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, config_id):
        # Restrict credential retrieval strictly to the authenticated user's organization
        config = get_object_or_404(
            PaymentGatewayCredential,
            id=config_id,
            organization=request.user.organization
        )

        return Response({
            "config_id": config.id,
            "gateway_provider": config.provider,
            "live_secret_key": config.live_secret_key,
            "public_key": config.publishable_key
        })
